#Goal
Systematically analyse the balance between cis (local and distal) and trans hopping, for different inserts.

# Setup
##Libraries
Load the libraries and set the parameters.
```{r load_libraries}

library(GenomicRanges)

library(ggbeeswarm)

split_string <- function(vect,sep,N1,N2=N1){
  library(stringr)
  sapply(vect, function(X){
    paste(str_split(X,sep)[[1]][N1:N2],collapse = sep)
  },USE.NAMES = F)
}

```

# Load data

All single LP integration data was collected in ~/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure5_integration_locations_cargo/CM20260401_collect_mapped_ints_single_LPs.Rmd
Load them here
```{r}
all_ints_comb = read_tsv( "/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure5_integration_locations_cargo/CM20260104_collected_mapped_ints_all.tsv")

all_ints_comb = all_ints_comb %>%
  mutate(type = replace_na(type,'pool')) 

#E2401 has pcr contaminations that are unresolved in the 'collect mapped ints all' object, instead get the correct filtering from the CTCF paper
tib_E2401_curated_strict = readRDS("/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure5_integration_locations_cargo/E2401_curated_strict.rds") 

tib_E2401_curated_strict_ctrls = tib_E2401_curated_strict %>%
  dplyr::mutate(insert = case_when(insert == "CBS1x_Fw_Sox2P" ~ '1xCTCF_fw_Sox2P',
                                   insert == "CBS3x_Fw_Sox2P" ~ '3xCTCF_fw_Sox2P',
                                   insert == "CBS3x_Rv_Sox2P" ~ '3xCTCF_rv_Sox2P',
                                     .default = insert)) %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "control pool") %>%
  mutate(LP = "-116 kb",
         LP_coordinate = 34643961,
         LP_chr = "chr3",
         genotype = "WT",
         hopped = start != LP_coordinate,
         dist_to_LP = case_when(chr == LP_chr ~ start - LP_coordinate,
                                .default = NA),
         local_hop = abs(dist_to_LP) < distance_local_hop & !is.na(dist_to_LP) & hopped) %>%
  filter(experiment == "E2401")
```

```{r}
#expected fraction based on chr lengths
chromsizes = read_tsv('/DATA/usr/c.moene/projects/Hopping_technology/Explore_existing_data/rds/mm10.chrom.sizes', 
                      col_names = c('chromosome', 'length'))

chrom_fract = chromsizes %>%
  mutate(chrom_fract = length/sum(length))

```


# Pools

## test read cutoff
Load the data and do very mild filtering
```{r}
all_pool_data = all_ints_comb %>%
  filter(genotype == "WT") %>%
  filter(LP != "T201") %>% #has two launch sites, confusing
  filter(type == "pool") %>%
  #replace E2401 with filtered version
  filter(experiment != "E2401") %>%
  bind_rows(tib_E2401_curated_strict_ctrls)

#remove any possible bleedthrough from other samples
all_LP_starts = all_ints_comb %>%
  mutate(LP_chr_start = paste0(LP_chr, "_", LP_coordinate)) %>%
  pull(LP_chr_start) %>%
  unique()
  

all_pool_data_filt = all_pool_data %>%
  mutate(chr_start = paste0(chr, "_", start)) %>%
  filter(!chr_start %in% all_LP_starts)  %>%
  filter(!chr %in% c("Tn5_plasmid","chrY", "chrM") ) #irrelevant chromosomes, cell line is female


```


Look at the read_count threshold: is 2 reads good to remove noise from other chromosomes?
```{r}
#observed fractions
launch_chr_int_count_pools_persample = 
  all_pool_data_filt %>%
  #rough classification of samples
  mutate(sample_new = paste0(experiment, "_", LP, "_", insert, "_", replicate, "_", techrep)) %>%
  mutate(on_launch_chr = chr == LP_chr) %>%
  group_by(experiment,sample_new, LP, LP_coordinate, LP_chr, insert, genotype, on_launch_chr) %>%
  #calculate N ints at various read_count thresholds
  summarize(N_ints_1 = sum(read_count >= 1),
            N_ints_2 = sum(read_count >= 2),
            N_ints_3 = sum(read_count >= 3),
            N_ints_5 = sum(read_count >= 5)
            ) %>%
  mutate(fract_ints_1 = N_ints_1 / sum(N_ints_1),
         fract_ints_2 = N_ints_2 / sum(N_ints_2),
         fract_ints_3 = N_ints_3 / sum(N_ints_3),
         fract_ints_5 = N_ints_5 / sum(N_ints_5),
         ) %>%
  left_join(chrom_fract, by=c('LP_chr' = 'chromosome'))

launch_chr_int_count_pools_persample_long = launch_chr_int_count_pools_persample %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("N_ints", "fract_ints")),
    names_to = c(".value", "read_count_threshold"),
    names_pattern = "(N_ints|fract_ints)_(\\d+)"
  )

#color by threshold
ggplot(filter(launch_chr_int_count_pools_persample_long, on_launch_chr),
       aes(x = read_count_threshold, size = N_ints, y = fract_ints,  col = read_count_threshold)) + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ insert + LP) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))+
  ylab("fraction of integrations on launch chromosome") +
  theme_bw()
```

Indeed, for all samples, from 2 reads onwards the fraction is stable, suggesting that 2 reads is a good cut-off.

Use the techreps of E1845 to judge whether there is a bias from tagmentation depth
```{r}
launch_chr_int_count_pools_persample_long  %>%
  filter(experiment == "E1845" & read_count_threshold == 2 & on_launch_chr )
```

fractions on the launch chromosome are quite comparable between the techreps and definitely much more different between the samples. So saturation is not a big issue here.


## local vs cis vs trans
### preprocessing

First properly combine replicates, then calculate the fractions=
```{r}

loc_cis_trans_ints  =   all_pool_data_filt %>%
  filter(read_count >= 2) %>%
  #rough classification of samples
  mutate(sample_for_plot = paste0(experiment, "_", LP, "_", insert, "_", replicate)) %>% #this merges the techreps of E1845, without deduplicating
  group_by(sample_for_plot) %>%
  mutate(N_ints_sample = n()) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(N_ints_sample >= 10) %>%
  mutate(on_launch_chr = chr == LP_chr,
         local_hop = on_launch_chr & abs(start - LP_coordinate) < distance_local_hop,
         int_location = case_when(local_hop ~ "local",
                                  on_launch_chr ~ "cis", #cis excludes the local hops
                                  .default = 'trans'),
         int_location = factor(int_location, levels = c('local','cis','trans'))) %>%
  group_by(experiment,sample_for_plot, LP, LP_coordinate, LP_chr, insert, insert_name, genotype, int_location) %>%
  #calculate fraction of integrations for cis, trans
  summarize(N_ints = n()) %>%
  mutate(fract_ints = N_ints/sum(N_ints))

#there are missing combinations in here, add them:
all_combis = loc_cis_trans_ints %>% 
  tidyr::expand(int_location)

loc_cis_trans_ints_full = loc_cis_trans_ints  %>% 
  right_join(all_combis) %>%
  replace_na(list(N_ints = 0, fract_ints = 0)) %>%
  mutate(total_ints = sum(N_ints)) %>%
  left_join(chrom_fract, by=c('LP_chr' = 'chromosome'))


loc_cis_trans_ints_annot = loc_cis_trans_ints_full %>%
  mutate(insert_group_1 = case_when(grepl('Nanog', insert)~ "Nanog promoter reporter",
                                    insert == "minimal insert" ~ "minimal insert",
                                    insert == "pMV001" ~ "enhancer",
                                    insert == "Sox2P_CDS" ~ "gene",
                                    grepl("CTCF", insert) & grepl("Sox2P", insert) ~ "CTCF+promoter",
                                    grepl("CTCF", insert) ~ "CTCF",
                                    grepl("Sox2P", insert) ~ "Sox2P",
                                  grepl('pLE', insert) ~ "TF reporter"),
         insert_group_1 = factor(insert_group_1, levels =  c("minimal insert", "Sox2P","Nanog promoter reporter", "TF reporter", "gene", "CTCF", "CTCF+promoter", "enhancer")),
         insert_category = case_when(insert_group_1 %in% c("Nanog promoter reporter","Sox2P", "TF reporter" ) ~ "promoter",
                                     .default = insert_group_1),
         insert_category = factor(insert_category, levels = c("minimal insert", "promoter", "gene", "CTCF", "CTCF+promoter", "enhancer")))

```

### plot all data
Filter out LP-39kb and Nanog_2 (not used in the paper)
```{r S6A_overview_trans_hopping_all_filtered}

loc_cis_trans_ints_annot %>%
  filter(genotype == "WT") %>%
  filter(!LP %in% c("N2", "-39 kb")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = insert_group_1, y = fract_ints)) +
  facet_grid(int_location ~ ., scales='free_x', space = 'free_x') +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0, aes(col = LP)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines")) +
  xlab("insert type")+
  ylab("fraction of integrations")

```



### Sox2 -116 kb
-116 kb, one dot per sample
```{r 5H_trans_hopping_Sox2_locus, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
insert_category_cols <- c(
  "promoter" = "#1B9E77",
  "gene" = "#D95F02",
  "CTCF" = "#7570B3",
  "CTCF+promoter" = "#E7298A",
  "minimal insert" = "#666666",
  "enhancer" = "#E6AB02"
)

colscale_insert_cat = scale_color_manual(values = insert_category_cols, aesthetics = 'col')

plot_cistrans_LP23 = loc_cis_trans_ints_annot %>%
  filter(genotype == "WT" & LP == "-116 kb") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = insert, y = fract_ints, col = insert_category)) +
  facet_nested(int_location  ~ insert_category,  scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x') +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0)+
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"),
        legend.position = 'none') +
  xlab("insert type")+
  ylab("fraction of integrations") +
  colscale_insert_cat 
plot_cistrans_LP23
```
